purpose: Stable public identifiers for Stödassistenten capabilities. The catalog describes module boundaries and enforcement requirements, not pricing, subscriptions, user entitlements or private implementation details.

capabilities.description: Basic situations-based matching against the limited verified support set exposed by the current public product surface.
Show safe public source metadata, verification context and next-step links for a displayed support candidate.
Extended matching that can use the private verified support corpus and server-side matching logic when available.
Persist selected support opportunities or monitoring preferences for an authenticated user or organization.
Create and manage private document checklists, drafts or uploaded document references for an authorized case context.
Analyze an authorized private document to explain content or identify missing information without exposing the private implementation.
Maintain private case state, progress and next actions for an authenticated subject with explicit authorization.
Read authorized case history and status transitions while preserving auditability and case isolation.
Allow authorized professional collaboration around a case with role-based access and explicit relationship checks.
Provide privacy-preserving aggregate product or organizational analytics without exposing individual case records.
Allow authenticated machine-to-machine access to explicitly authorized product functions through a private API layer.
